summary.zh: 同步上游稳定版 v0.446.6，修复 Marketplace 旧版技能偏好迁移可能覆盖用户重新启用的技能，以及凭据权限修复误触非 Marketplace 运行时路径的问题。
summary.en: Syncs upstream stable v0.446.6 and fixes two Marketplace regressions: legacy skill opt-out re-migration could re-disable a user-enabled skill after reload, and credential permission healing used unsafe directory-depth discovery instead of install-record-qualified identities.

title.zh: Marketplace 旧版技能偏好迁移修正
title.en: Marketplace legacy skill opt-out migration correction

summary.zh: 旧版技能禁用偏好现在只迁移一次：配置拥有完成元数据，注册表在锁内原子批处理删除旧记录，用户重新启用后不会被重新禁用。
summary.en: Legacy skill disabled preferences now migrate exactly once: agent configuration owns completion metadata, the registry retires exact legacy records in one locked batch, and a later user enable is never re-disabled on reload.

sources.title: fix(marketplace): retire legacy opt-outs exactly once and heal source-qualified credentials

summary.zh: 凭据权限修复改为只处理已验证安装记录的 Marketplace 身份路径，使用 lstat 和 O_NOFOLLOW 描述符保护，不再递归遍历插件运行时数据。
summary.en: Credential permission healing now targets only install-record-qualified Marketplace identity paths with lstat and O_NOFOLLOW descriptor guards, replacing unsafe directory-depth traversal.

sources.title: fix(marketplace): retire legacy opt-outs exactly once and heal source-qualified credentials
